submission.natural_language_explanation: This negative pole is a retrospective register sensor: it rests at its GELU-floor ceiling on tokens of everyday, narrative, literary and abstract diction, and it deactivates toward zero on tokens of present-day reportage diction (news, institutional, commercial, financial and technical vocabulary) even when those words are abstract, with calendar and time vocabulary on the active side (months and weekdays peaking Thursday/Saturday and weakest Monday, plus morning, former, latter) as one coordinate of a six-pole family. In longer, more diverse left contexts the deactivation also pulls weakly-driven tokens such as articles, prepositions and commas toward zero, so whole-sentence strength is set by the strongly-driven content words.
